privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Agreement — BRW
privacy.description: Artamid LLC policy on personal data processing: purposes, retention, user rights and protection measures.
privacy.heading: Personal Data Processing Agreement
privacy.lead: The personal data processing policy of Artamid LLC. By submitting a form, placing an order or using the website, you agree to its terms.

sections.title: General provisions
sections.body:
1.1. This document sets out the policy of Artamid LLC (registered address: 26 Nepokorennykh Blvd., Mogilev 212025, Republic of Belarus; the "Company") on the processing of personal data (the "Policy").

1.2. The purpose of the Policy is to comply with the personal data legislation of the Republic of Belarus and to protect the interests of data subjects (the "users").

1.3. The Policy applies to all personal data received by the Company:

- in the performance of concluded (or planned) transactions;
- when orders and enquiries are placed on the Company's website (the "Website");
- to give users access to the information published on the Website;
- obtained in any other way.

1.4. The Company processes and stores personal data in accordance with applicable law and this Policy in order to identify users; communicate with them; improve the quality of its services; send notifications and commercial offers; provide information about the Company's activities; run promotions and bonus programmes; send advertising and informational messages; assess and analyse the operation of the Website; and inform users about promotions, discounts and special offers.

1.5. The Policy applies to the Company's processes in which personal data is processed and stored, including with the use of automation tools.

1.6. The current version of the Policy is published on the Website in open access and takes effect from the moment of publication.

1.7. Persons who submit personal data to the Company must read the Policy. By ticking "I agree" next to a link to this Policy, visiting the Website or providing their personal data, the user consents to the processing of that data on the terms set out in the Policy and confirms that they have read it and agree to its terms.

1.8. This Policy is an integral part of the contracts concluded with the Company where their terms expressly say so.

1.9. This Policy applies to the Website only. The Company does not control, and is not responsible for, third-party websites that users may reach through links on the Website.

faq.title: Questions and answers — BRW
faq.description: Answers to common questions about ordering, delivery, payment, installments, returns and the Black Red White store in Mogilev.
faq.heading: Questions and answers
faq.lead: We have collected answers to what we are asked most often. Can't find yours? Call us and we will help.

items.q: Can I buy furniture in Belarus and send it to Russia?
items.a:
Yes, but only if you arrange everything yourself: finding a carrier and paying for delivery and any related services.

Black Red White is not responsible for damage to the goods in transit to the destination.

items.q: What documents do I need for an installment plan?
items.a: To pay with an installment card you need the card itself and your passport. For bank loans the list of documents depends on the bank and the programme; the terms of every option are on the [Installment](/installment) page.

items.q: Can I place an order on the website and pay in installments?
items.a: Yes. Place the order on the website and pay for it with an installment card (Halva, Purchase Card, Turtle) in the store. Details are on the [Installment](/installment) page.

items.q: Can I only buy in the store, or is there online payment?
items.a: You can place an order in the Mogilev store or on the website. Online card payment on the website is not available yet: you can pay in cash to the courier on delivery in Mogilev, or in the store. Read more in [Delivery and payment](/delivery-and-payment).

We publish current promotions and special offers in the [News](/news) section. The terms of some promotions depend on the furniture manufacturer, so please check with a store consultant.

Promotions and discount programmes do not apply when you pay with an installment card.

items.q: I placed an order. How do I find out it is ready?
items.a: Orders are handled by the consultants of the Black Red White store. You can find out the status of your order by calling the store at +375 29 622 67 67.

items.q: Can I use an installment plan?
items.a: Yes. Installment cards let you pay over 2 to 8 months, and bank loans and installments run for up to 7 years. The terms, rates and conditions of each programme are on the [Installment](/installment) page.

items.q: What are the delivery terms for orders placed on the website?
items.a: Delivery terms depend on the city (or locality) and the order amount. Full information is in [Delivery and payment](/delivery-and-payment).

items.q: Do you sell office chairs, desks, mattresses or coat stands?
items.a: Our main range is Black Red White cabinet furniture, which is in the [catalog](/catalog). Related goods from other suppliers are not always in stock, so please check availability in the store.

items.q: What is discontinued stock, and why is it limited?
items.a:
Discontinued furniture is furniture with the status “No longer produced”. It is sold until the warehouse stock runs out, because no further batches will be made.

Ask the store consultants about the availability of discontinued items and whether you can order them.

items.q: Is a particular furniture item in stock?
items.a: It is best to check the availability of specific items in the remaining stock with the store consultants by phone.

items.q: I can't find the assembly instructions. What should I do?
items.a: Contact the store where you placed the order and we will tell you where to find the instructions for your model.

items.q: Where can I see a furniture set in person?
items.a: To find out whether a particular sample is on display, call the store. The store address and phone are on the [About us](/about) page.

items.q: How long does it take to consider a complaint?
items.a: The store must give the buyer an official reply within 14 days of the enquiry, as required by the legislation of the Republic of Belarus.

items.q: I found the display cabinet glass cracked when unpacking. How do I get the part replaced?
items.a: Contact the store where you placed the order and we will help you arrange a replacement.

items.q: Where do I go with questions about cooperation?
items.a: For cooperation and commercial proposals, call us at +375 29 622 67 67 or write to info@brw-shop.by.
For furniture assembly, contact the store consultants: they will advise on terms and timing.

items.q: Are there stores in other cities?
items.a: Our store is in Mogilev, and we deliver orders across Belarus. The address and phone are on the [About us](/about) page.

items.q: I want to give my parents a gift. Can I order here and deliver to another city?
items.a: Yes. When placing the order, enter the city and address the furniture should be delivered to. Delivery terms are in [Delivery and payment](/delivery-and-payment).

delivery.title: Delivery across Belarus
delivery.text: from 2 days · free in Mogilev over 500 BYN

delivery.question: How does delivery work?
delivery.answer: We deliver across Belarus from 2 days. A manager agrees the date and time, and the driver calls before leaving. Delivery in Mogilev is free over 500 BYN.

assembly.question: Do you assemble the furniture?
assembly.answer: Yes, our fitters assemble it on the delivery day. Assembly costs from 10% of the price; a manager will give the exact amount.

warranty.question: What is the warranty?
warranty.answer: BRW furniture comes with an 18-month warranty. If a factory defect is found, we replace the part or the item.
